question: In 2023, which Indian Tennis player became the oldest to win the ATP Masters 1000 title?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rohan Bopanna.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rohan Bopanna:-**

 
 
• He became the oldest Indian Tennis player to win the ATP Masters 1000 title in 2023.
 
• This achievement was a significant milestone in Bopanna's career and a proud moment for Indian tennis. ​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahesh Bhupathi:-**

 
 
• He is a former doubles world number one and has won numerous Grand Slam titles in doubles and mixed doubles.
 
 
 
• **Vijay Amritraj and Ramanathan Krishnan are both former top-ranked Indian singles players who have represented India in multiple Davis Cup matches.**
 
• **ATP Masters 1000:-**
 
 
• It is a series of nine men's tennis tournaments that form part of the elite ATP Tour. Winning a Masters 1000 title is a significant achievement for any tennis player.
